proposals.risk_realized: A credential (the full credential object, likely including the secret/API key value) enters the safe log context under the key_id field, violating the requirement that credential values must never be copied into diagnostic artifacts.
proposals.summary: key_id field replaced with the raw credential object instead of its safe identifier, exposing the secret value in every provider/capability log context.

proposals.risk_realized: Provider kwargs (which can carry arbitrary request contents, including credential or prompt data) are merged directly into the safe log context, so unbounded provider-controlled fields can appear in diagnostic artifacts.
proposals.summary: Developer adds provider-supplied request kwargs into the log context for extra debugging detail, spreading arbitrary provider arguments (which may include prompt/credential data) into the returned dict.

proposals.risk_realized: Full prompt/message content is copied into the log context, exposing request contents (potentially containing embedded credentials or sensitive prompt text) in runtime logs.
proposals.summary: Developer includes the outbound message/prompt payload alongside model metadata to help debug request routing, leaking prompt content into the log context.
